bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
OV=$(mktemp --suffix=.yaml); trap 'rm -f "$OV"' EXIT
printf 'services:\n  gaybbs:\n    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:posting-menu-resume-20a6020\n' > "$OV"
set +e
OUT=$(docker compose -p deploy -f "$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -f "$OV" run --rm --no-deps gaybbs node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/recolorPublishedPostingMenus.mjs --resume 2>&1)
EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e
INV=$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep '^POSTING_MENU_INVENTORY ' | tail -1 || true)
SUMMARY=$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep '^POSTING_MENU_EDIT_SUMMARY ' | tail -1 || true)
FAILS=$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep '^TOPIC_MENU_EDIT_FAILED ' | sed -E 's/^TOPIC_MENU_EDIT_FAILED ([^ ]+) code=([^ ]+) retry_after=([^ ]+).*$/FAIL topic=\1 code=\2 retry_after=\3/' | head -n 12 || true)
test -n "$SUMMARY" || exit 31
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "$(printf 'GAYBBS_POSTING_MENU_RESUME_2_20261113 exit=%s\n%s\n%s\n%s' "$EXIT_CODE" "$INV" "$SUMMARY" "$FAILS")" >/dev/null || exit 32
test "$EXIT_CODE" -eq 0 || exit 33
echo POSTING_MENU_RESUME_TWO_RECORDED
